metadata.author: Liz Wegner Proprietary Software Collective - Liz Wegner, LLMSW

interventions.title: Cognitive Restructuring
interventions.description: Supported client in identifying cognitive distortions and negative automatic thoughts and developing more balanced, realistic, and adaptive thinking patterns.
interventions.fullText: Cognitive Restructuring: Supported client in identifying cognitive distortions and negative automatic thoughts and developing more balanced, realistic, and adaptive thinking patterns.

interventions.title: Identification of Automatic Thoughts
interventions.description: Assisted client in recognizing automatic thoughts associated with distressing situations to increase awareness of the relationship between cognitions, emotions, and behaviors.
interventions.fullText: Identification of Automatic Thoughts: Assisted client in recognizing automatic thoughts associated with distressing situations to increase awareness of the relationship between cognitions, emotions, and behaviors.

interventions.title: Identification of Cognitive Distortions
interventions.description: Guided client in identifying cognitive distortions, including catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, mind reading, and personalization, that contribute to emotional distress.
interventions.fullText: Identification of Cognitive Distortions: Guided client in identifying cognitive distortions, including catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, mind reading, and personalization, that contribute to emotional distress.

interventions.title: Socratic Questioning
interventions.description: Utilized guided questioning to help client evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of distressing thoughts and develop alternative interpretations.
interventions.fullText: Socratic Questioning: Utilized guided questioning to help client evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of distressing thoughts and develop alternative interpretations.

interventions.title: Examination of Evidence
interventions.description: Assisted client in evaluating evidence supporting and contradicting distressing beliefs to promote balanced, evidence-based conclusions.
interventions.fullText: Examination of Evidence: Assisted client in evaluating evidence supporting and contradicting distressing beliefs to promote balanced, evidence-based conclusions.

interventions.title: Cognitive Reframing
interventions.description: Supported client in considering alternative perspectives on distressing situations to reduce negative interpretations and promote adaptive emotional responses.
interventions.fullText: Cognitive Reframing: Supported client in considering alternative perspectives on distressing situations to reduce negative interpretations and promote adaptive emotional responses.

interventions.title: Decatastrophizing
interventions.description: Guided client in examining feared outcomes, assessing their likelihood, and identifying coping strategies to reduce catastrophic thinking and anticipatory anxiety.
interventions.fullText: Decatastrophizing: Guided client in examining feared outcomes, assessing their likelihood, and identifying coping strategies to reduce catastrophic thinking and anticipatory anxiety.

interventions.title: Identification and Modification of Core Beliefs
interventions.description: Explored underlying beliefs about self, others, and the world and supported client in developing more balanced beliefs through examination of evidence and lived experiences.
interventions.fullText: Identification and Modification of Core Beliefs: Explored underlying beliefs about self, others, and the world and supported client in developing more balanced beliefs through examination of evidence and lived experiences.

interventions.title: Self-Critical Thought Restructuring
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying and challenging harsh self-evaluations and developing more balanced self-appraisals to reduce shame and negative self-perception.
interventions.fullText: Self-Critical Thought Restructuring: Assisted client in identifying and challenging harsh self-evaluations and developing more balanced self-appraisals to reduce shame and negative self-perception.

interventions.title: Cognitive Flexibility Development
interventions.description: Encouraged client to consider multiple interpretations of distressing situations and move away from rigid conclusions to improve emotional and behavioral flexibility.
interventions.fullText: Cognitive Flexibility Development: Encouraged client to consider multiple interpretations of distressing situations and move away from rigid conclusions to improve emotional and behavioral flexibility.

interventions.title: Behavioral Activation
interventions.description: Collaboratively identified meaningful and reinforcing activities to increase behavioral engagement and reduce withdrawal and depressive symptoms.
interventions.fullText: Behavioral Activation: Collaboratively identified meaningful and reinforcing activities to increase behavioral engagement and reduce withdrawal and depressive symptoms.

interventions.title: Activity Scheduling
interventions.description: Assisted client in developing a structured activity schedule to increase engagement in pleasurable, necessary, and goal-directed activities.
interventions.fullText: Activity Scheduling: Assisted client in developing a structured activity schedule to increase engagement in pleasurable, necessary, and goal-directed activities.

interventions.title: Graded Task Assignment
interventions.description: Collaboratively broke overwhelming tasks into smaller, manageable steps to reduce avoidance and improve task completion.
interventions.fullText: Graded Task Assignment: Collaboratively broke overwhelming tasks into smaller, manageable steps to reduce avoidance and improve task completion.

interventions.title: Task Initiation Strategies
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying practical strategies to initiate difficult or avoided tasks and reduce barriers associated with anxiety, low motivation, or perceived overwhelm.
interventions.fullText: Task Initiation Strategies: Assisted client in identifying practical strategies to initiate difficult or avoided tasks and reduce barriers associated with anxiety, low motivation, or perceived overwhelm.

interventions.title: Goal Setting
interventions.description: Supported client in establishing specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound goals to improve behavioral follow-through and progress toward treatment objectives.
interventions.fullText: Goal Setting: Supported client in establishing specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound goals to improve behavioral follow-through and progress toward treatment objectives.

interventions.title: Problem-Solving Training
interventions.description: Guided client in identifying problems, generating potential solutions, evaluating alternatives, and developing actionable plans to address current stressors.
interventions.fullText: Problem-Solving Training: Guided client in identifying problems, generating potential solutions, evaluating alternatives, and developing actionable plans to address current stressors.

interventions.title: Behavioral Experimentation
interventions.description: Collaboratively developed behavioral experiments to test distressing beliefs and gather real-world evidence regarding anticipated outcomes.
interventions.fullText: Behavioral Experimentation: Collaboratively developed behavioral experiments to test distressing beliefs and gather real-world evidence regarding anticipated outcomes.

interventions.title: Reduction of Avoidance Behaviors
interventions.description: Helped client identify avoidance patterns that maintain distress and develop alternative behavioral responses that support adaptive functioning.
interventions.fullText: Reduction of Avoidance Behaviors: Helped client identify avoidance patterns that maintain distress and develop alternative behavioral responses that support adaptive functioning.

interventions.title: Routine Development
interventions.description: Collaboratively explored strategies for establishing consistent daily routines to support functioning, reduce decision-making demands, and increase behavioral consistency.
interventions.fullText: Routine Development: Collaboratively explored strategies for establishing consistent daily routines to support functioning, reduce decision-making demands, and increase behavioral consistency.

interventions.title: Behavioral Rehearsal
interventions.description: Practiced alternative behavioral responses to anticipated situations through role-play or structured exercises to improve confidence and skill implementation outside therapy.
interventions.fullText: Behavioral Rehearsal: Practiced alternative behavioral responses to anticipated situations through role-play or structured exercises to improve confidence and skill implementation outside therapy.

interventions.title: Identification of Anxiety Triggers
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying situations, thoughts, bodily sensations, and interpersonal experiences that trigger anxiety to increase awareness of antecedents and maintaining factors.
interventions.fullText: Identification of Anxiety Triggers: Assisted client in identifying situations, thoughts, bodily sensations, and interpersonal experiences that trigger anxiety to increase awareness of antecedents and maintaining factors.

interventions.title: Worry Identification and Differentiation
interventions.description: Helped client distinguish productive problem-solving from repetitive, hypothetical worry to support more effective responses to anxiety-provoking concerns.
interventions.fullText: Worry Identification and Differentiation: Helped client distinguish productive problem-solving from repetitive, hypothetical worry to support more effective responses to anxiety-provoking concerns.

interventions.title: Probability Estimation
interventions.description: Assisted client in evaluating the realistic likelihood of feared outcomes to challenge overestimation of risk and reduce anticipatory anxiety.
interventions.fullText: Probability Estimation: Assisted client in evaluating the realistic likelihood of feared outcomes to challenge overestimation of risk and reduce anticipatory anxiety.

interventions.title: Intolerance of Uncertainty Restructuring
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying beliefs about uncertainty and developing more flexible responses to situations in which certainty or reassurance is unavailable.
interventions.fullText: Intolerance of Uncertainty Restructuring: Assisted client in identifying beliefs about uncertainty and developing more flexible responses to situations in which certainty or reassurance is unavailable.

interventions.title: Reassurance-Seeking Reduction
interventions.description: Helped client recognize repetitive reassurance-seeking patterns and develop strategies to tolerate uncertainty and respond more adaptively to distressing concerns.
interventions.fullText: Reassurance-Seeking Reduction: Helped client recognize repetitive reassurance-seeking patterns and develop strategies to tolerate uncertainty and respond more adaptively to distressing concerns.

interventions.title: Exposure-Based Behavioral Practice
interventions.description: Supported client in gradually approaching feared or avoided situations to reduce avoidance and increase tolerance of anxiety-provoking experiences.
interventions.fullText: Exposure-Based Behavioral Practice: Supported client in gradually approaching feared or avoided situations to reduce avoidance and increase tolerance of anxiety-provoking experiences.

interventions.title: Exposure Hierarchy Development
interventions.description: Assisted client in ranking feared or avoided situations according to anticipated distress to guide gradual, structured exposure practice.
interventions.fullText: Exposure Hierarchy Development: Assisted client in ranking feared or avoided situations according to anticipated distress to guide gradual, structured exposure practice.

interventions.title: Coping Skills Rehearsal
interventions.description: Practiced adaptive coping responses to anticipated stressors to increase confidence and improve management of anxiety-related symptoms.
interventions.fullText: Coping Skills Rehearsal: Practiced adaptive coping responses to anticipated stressors to increase confidence and improve management of anxiety-related symptoms.

interventions.title: Diaphragmatic Breathing
interventions.description: Practiced diaphragmatic breathing to support physiological regulation and reduce anxiety-related arousal.
interventions.fullText: Diaphragmatic Breathing: Practiced diaphragmatic breathing to support physiological regulation and reduce anxiety-related arousal.

interventions.title: Relaxation Training
interventions.description: Introduced or practiced relaxation strategies to reduce physiological tension and support management of stress and anxiety symptoms.
interventions.fullText: Relaxation Training: Introduced or practiced relaxation strategies to reduce physiological tension and support management of stress and anxiety symptoms.

interventions.title: Emotion-Thought-Behavior Mapping
interventions.description: Guided client in examining the relationship between triggering events, interpretations, emotional responses, physiological sensations, and subsequent behaviors.
interventions.fullText: Emotion-Thought-Behavior Mapping: Guided client in examining the relationship between triggering events, interpretations, emotional responses, physiological sensations, and subsequent behaviors.

interventions.title: Emotion Identification
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying and labeling emotional experiences associated with triggering situations to improve emotional awareness and clarify underlying needs.
interventions.fullText: Emotion Identification: Assisted client in identifying and labeling emotional experiences associated with triggering situations to improve emotional awareness and clarify underlying needs.

interventions.title: Trigger-Response Analysis
interventions.description: Supported client in identifying antecedents and consequences of emotional reactions to increase awareness of behavioral patterns and opportunities for intervention.
interventions.fullText: Trigger-Response Analysis: Supported client in identifying antecedents and consequences of emotional reactions to increase awareness of behavioral patterns and opportunities for intervention.

interventions.title: Emotional Response Reappraisal
interventions.description: Helped client examine interpretations contributing to emotional intensity and develop more balanced appraisals to support adaptive responses.
interventions.fullText: Emotional Response Reappraisal: Helped client examine interpretations contributing to emotional intensity and develop more balanced appraisals to support adaptive responses.

interventions.title: Rumination Interruption and Cognitive Refocusing
interventions.description: Assisted client in recognizing repetitive, unproductive thought patterns and redirecting attention toward constructive problem-solving, balanced reflection, or goal-directed activities.
interventions.fullText: Rumination Interruption and Cognitive Refocusing: Assisted client in recognizing repetitive, unproductive thought patterns and redirecting attention toward constructive problem-solving, balanced reflection, or goal-directed activities.

interventions.title: Interpersonal Cognitive Restructuring
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying and evaluating negative interpretations of interpersonal interactions to promote more balanced appraisals and reduce relational distress.
interventions.fullText: Interpersonal Cognitive Restructuring: Assisted client in identifying and evaluating negative interpretations of interpersonal interactions to promote more balanced appraisals and reduce relational distress.

interventions.title: Examination of Interpersonal Assumptions
interventions.description: Explored client’s beliefs regarding others’ intentions, expectations, and reactions to distinguish observable evidence from unverified assumptions.
interventions.fullText: Examination of Interpersonal Assumptions: Explored client’s beliefs regarding others’ intentions, expectations, and reactions to distinguish observable evidence from unverified assumptions.

interventions.title: Perspective-Taking
interventions.description: Encouraged client to consider alternative perspectives and explanations for others’ behaviors to increase cognitive flexibility and reduce interpersonal misinterpretation.
interventions.fullText: Perspective-Taking: Encouraged client to consider alternative perspectives and explanations for others’ behaviors to increase cognitive flexibility and reduce interpersonal misinterpretation.

interventions.title: Communication Skills Training
interventions.description: Supported client in identifying and practicing clear, direct, and respectful communication strategies to improve interpersonal functioning and reduce conflict.
interventions.fullText: Communication Skills Training: Supported client in identifying and practicing clear, direct, and respectful communication strategies to improve interpersonal functioning and reduce conflict.

interventions.title: Assertiveness Training
interventions.description: Assisted client in developing assertive communication skills to express needs, preferences, and boundaries while maintaining respect for others.
interventions.fullText: Assertiveness Training: Assisted client in developing assertive communication skills to express needs, preferences, and boundaries while maintaining respect for others.

interventions.title: Conflict Pattern Identification
interventions.description: Explored recurring cognitive and behavioral patterns during interpersonal conflict to identify triggers, maintaining factors, and opportunities for alternative responses.
interventions.fullText: Conflict Pattern Identification: Explored recurring cognitive and behavioral patterns during interpersonal conflict to identify triggers, maintaining factors, and opportunities for alternative responses.

interventions.title: Interpretation Versus Observation
interventions.description: Assisted client in distinguishing observable behaviors from personal interpretations to reduce assumptions and support more accurate interpersonal communication.
interventions.fullText: Interpretation Versus Observation: Assisted client in distinguishing observable behaviors from personal interpretations to reduce assumptions and support more accurate interpersonal communication.

interventions.title: Response Inhibition and Delayed Responding
interventions.description: Collaboratively explored strategies for pausing before responding to emotionally activating situations to reduce impulsive reactions and promote intentional communication.
interventions.fullText: Response Inhibition and Delayed Responding: Collaboratively explored strategies for pausing before responding to emotionally activating situations to reduce impulsive reactions and promote intentional communication.

interventions.title: Perfectionistic Thinking Restructuring
interventions.description: Helped client identify rigid standards and perfectionistic expectations contributing to distress and develop more flexible, realistic performance expectations.
interventions.fullText: Perfectionistic Thinking Restructuring: Helped client identify rigid standards and perfectionistic expectations contributing to distress and develop more flexible, realistic performance expectations.

interventions.title: Fear of Negative Evaluation Restructuring
interventions.description: Assisted client in examining beliefs about being judged or rejected by others and evaluating the evidence supporting anticipated negative evaluations.
interventions.fullText: Fear of Negative Evaluation Restructuring: Assisted client in examining beliefs about being judged or rejected by others and evaluating the evidence supporting anticipated negative evaluations.

interventions.title: Hopelessness Cognitive Restructuring
interventions.description: Supported client in examining negative predictions about the future and identifying realistic alternatives to global beliefs about helplessness or hopelessness.
interventions.fullText: Hopelessness Cognitive Restructuring: Supported client in examining negative predictions about the future and identifying realistic alternatives to global beliefs about helplessness or hopelessness.

interventions.title: Strengths Identification
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying personal strengths, past successes, and effective coping responses to challenge negatively biased self-evaluations.
interventions.fullText: Strengths Identification: Assisted client in identifying personal strengths, past successes, and effective coping responses to challenge negatively biased self-evaluations.

interventions.title: Trauma-Related Cognitive Restructuring
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying and evaluating trauma-related beliefs about safety, trust, control, and self-worth that contribute to current emotional distress.
interventions.fullText: Trauma-Related Cognitive Restructuring: Assisted client in identifying and evaluating trauma-related beliefs about safety, trust, control, and self-worth that contribute to current emotional distress.

interventions.title: CBT Model Psychoeducation
interventions.description: Provided psychoeducation regarding the relationship between thoughts, emotions, physiological responses, and behaviors to increase understanding of factors contributing to current difficulties.
interventions.fullText: CBT Model Psychoeducation: Provided psychoeducation regarding the relationship between thoughts, emotions, physiological responses, and behaviors to increase understanding of factors contributing to current difficulties.

interventions.title: Homework Assignment and Review
interventions.description: Collaboratively developed or reviewed between-session practice activities to reinforce therapeutic skills, promote generalization outside therapy, and support progress toward treatment goals.
interventions.fullText: Homework Assignment and Review: Collaboratively developed or reviewed between-session practice activities to reinforce therapeutic skills, promote generalization outside therapy, and support progress toward treatment goals.

interventions.title: Cognitive Defusion
interventions.description: Supported client in recognizing distressing thoughts as mental events rather than objective facts to reduce cognitive fusion and increase behavioral flexibility.
interventions.fullText: Cognitive Defusion: Supported client in recognizing distressing thoughts as mental events rather than objective facts to reduce cognitive fusion and increase behavioral flexibility.

interventions.title: Thought Observation
interventions.description: Guided client in observing thoughts without judgment or immediate engagement to increase awareness of cognitive patterns and reduce reactivity.
interventions.fullText: Thought Observation: Guided client in observing thoughts without judgment or immediate engagement to increase awareness of cognitive patterns and reduce reactivity.

interventions.title: “I Am Having the Thought That…” Technique
interventions.description: Introduced language-based defusion strategies to help client create distance from distressing thoughts and recognize them as temporary mental experiences.
interventions.fullText: “I Am Having the Thought That…” Technique: Introduced language-based defusion strategies to help client create distance from distressing thoughts and recognize them as temporary mental experiences.

interventions.title: Defusion From Self-Critical Narratives
interventions.description: Assisted client in recognizing recurring self-critical narratives and practicing responses that reduce identification with negative self-evaluations.
interventions.fullText: Defusion From Self-Critical Narratives: Assisted client in recognizing recurring self-critical narratives and practicing responses that reduce identification with negative self-evaluations.

interventions.title: Defusion From Interpersonal Assumptions
interventions.description: Assisted client in observing assumptions about others’ thoughts, intentions, and judgments without automatically treating these interpretations as facts.
interventions.fullText: Defusion From Interpersonal Assumptions: Assisted client in observing assumptions about others’ thoughts, intentions, and judgments without automatically treating these interpretations as facts.

interventions.title: Defusion From Worry
interventions.description: Helped client recognize worry as ongoing mental activity rather than a reliable prediction of future events or a requirement for problem-solving.
interventions.fullText: Defusion From Worry: Helped client recognize worry as ongoing mental activity rather than a reliable prediction of future events or a requirement for problem-solving.

interventions.title: Acceptance-Based Intervention
interventions.description: Supported client in developing willingness to experience difficult internal experiences without excessive attempts to suppress, control, or eliminate them.
interventions.fullText: Acceptance-Based Intervention: Supported client in developing willingness to experience difficult internal experiences without excessive attempts to suppress, control, or eliminate them.

interventions.title: Emotional Acceptance
interventions.description: Encouraged client to acknowledge and allow emotional experiences without judgment to reduce experiential avoidance and support adaptive responding.
interventions.fullText: Emotional Acceptance: Encouraged client to acknowledge and allow emotional experiences without judgment to reduce experiential avoidance and support adaptive responding.

interventions.title: Willingness Development
interventions.description: Explored client’s willingness to experience discomfort in service of personally meaningful goals and identified barriers to engaging in values-consistent behavior.
interventions.fullText: Willingness Development: Explored client’s willingness to experience discomfort in service of personally meaningful goals and identified barriers to engaging in values-consistent behavior.

interventions.title: Experiential Avoidance Identification
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying behaviors used to escape, suppress, or avoid unwanted internal experiences and explored how these patterns affect daily functioning.
interventions.fullText: Experiential Avoidance Identification: Assisted client in identifying behaviors used to escape, suppress, or avoid unwanted internal experiences and explored how these patterns affect daily functioning.

interventions.title: Control Agenda Exploration
interventions.description: Examined the effectiveness of client’s efforts to control unwanted thoughts and emotions and explored whether these strategies contribute to ongoing distress or behavioral restriction.
interventions.fullText: Control Agenda Exploration: Examined the effectiveness of client’s efforts to control unwanted thoughts and emotions and explored whether these strategies contribute to ongoing distress or behavioral restriction.

interventions.title: Making Room for Emotions
interventions.description: Encouraged client to notice, allow, and make room for difficult emotional experiences without requiring them to change before taking constructive action.
interventions.fullText: Making Room for Emotions: Encouraged client to notice, allow, and make room for difficult emotional experiences without requiring them to change before taking constructive action.

interventions.title: Acceptance of Uncertainty
interventions.description: Supported client in practicing willingness to experience uncertainty without relying exclusively on reassurance, avoidance, or attempts to obtain complete certainty.
interventions.fullText: Acceptance of Uncertainty: Supported client in practicing willingness to experience uncertainty without relying exclusively on reassurance, avoidance, or attempts to obtain complete certainty.

interventions.title: Present-Moment Awareness
interventions.description: Guided client in directing attention toward current thoughts, emotions, bodily sensations, and environmental experiences to increase present-moment awareness and psychological flexibility.
interventions.fullText: Present-Moment Awareness: Guided client in directing attention toward current thoughts, emotions, bodily sensations, and environmental experiences to increase present-moment awareness and psychological flexibility.

interventions.title: Mindful Observation
interventions.description: Facilitated a mindfulness exercise to support nonjudgmental observation of internal and external experiences without immediate attempts to change or avoid them.
interventions.fullText: Mindful Observation: Facilitated a mindfulness exercise to support nonjudgmental observation of internal and external experiences without immediate attempts to change or avoid them.

interventions.title: Mindful Emotion Observation
interventions.description: Guided client in observing emotional experiences as changing internal events without immediately reacting or engaging in avoidance behaviors.
interventions.fullText: Mindful Emotion Observation: Guided client in observing emotional experiences as changing internal events without immediately reacting or engaging in avoidance behaviors.

interventions.title: Mindful Pause
interventions.description: Supported client in practicing a deliberate pause between internal experiences and behavioral responses to increase intentional, values-consistent decision-making.
interventions.fullText: Mindful Pause: Supported client in practicing a deliberate pause between internal experiences and behavioral responses to increase intentional, values-consistent decision-making.

interventions.title: Five-Senses Grounding
interventions.description: Guided client in directing attention toward sensory information in the immediate environment to strengthen present-moment contact during periods of distress.
interventions.fullText: Five-Senses Grounding: Guided client in directing attention toward sensory information in the immediate environment to strengthen present-moment contact during periods of distress.

interventions.title: Mindfulness of Interpersonal Triggers
interventions.description: Assisted client in noticing thoughts, emotions, and bodily reactions during interpersonal stress without immediately engaging in habitual reactive behaviors.
interventions.fullText: Mindfulness of Interpersonal Triggers: Assisted client in noticing thoughts, emotions, and bodily reactions during interpersonal stress without immediately engaging in habitual reactive behaviors.

interventions.title: Self-as-Context Exploration
interventions.description: Guided client in distinguishing the observing self from changing thoughts, feelings, memories, and experiences to reduce overidentification with distressing internal content.
interventions.fullText: Self-as-Context Exploration: Guided client in distinguishing the observing self from changing thoughts, feelings, memories, and experiences to reduce overidentification with distressing internal content.

interventions.title: Self-Concept Defusion
interventions.description: Assisted client in loosening attachment to rigid self-descriptions and exploring a broader sense of identity beyond labels, perceived shortcomings, or past experiences.
interventions.fullText: Self-Concept Defusion: Assisted client in loosening attachment to rigid self-descriptions and exploring a broader sense of identity beyond labels, perceived shortcomings, or past experiences.

interventions.title: Distancing From Self-Labels
interventions.description: Helped client recognize limiting identity statements as learned verbal descriptions rather than complete definitions of the self.
interventions.fullText: Distancing From Self-Labels: Helped client recognize limiting identity statements as learned verbal descriptions rather than complete definitions of the self.

interventions.title: Identity Beyond Emotional Experiences
interventions.description: Supported client in recognizing that difficult emotions and psychological symptoms are experiences they have rather than total definitions of who they are.
interventions.fullText: Identity Beyond Emotional Experiences: Supported client in recognizing that difficult emotions and psychological symptoms are experiences they have rather than total definitions of who they are.

interventions.title: Values Clarification
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying personally meaningful values to guide decision-making and increase alignment between daily behavior and desired ways of living.
interventions.fullText: Values Clarification: Assisted client in identifying personally meaningful values to guide decision-making and increase alignment between daily behavior and desired ways of living.

interventions.title: Values Versus Goals Differentiation
interventions.description: Helped client distinguish ongoing valued directions from specific achievable outcomes to support sustained, meaningful action regardless of immediate results.
interventions.fullText: Values Versus Goals Differentiation: Helped client distinguish ongoing valued directions from specific achievable outcomes to support sustained, meaningful action regardless of immediate results.

interventions.title: Values-Based Decision-Making
interventions.description: Supported client in evaluating available choices according to personally identified values rather than relying exclusively on short-term emotional relief or avoidance.
interventions.fullText: Values-Based Decision-Making: Supported client in evaluating available choices according to personally identified values rather than relying exclusively on short-term emotional relief or avoidance.

interventions.title: Values Conflict Exploration
interventions.description: Explored competing personal values and priorities contributing to indecision or distress to support greater clarity and intentional decision-making.
interventions.fullText: Values Conflict Exploration: Explored competing personal values and priorities contributing to indecision or distress to support greater clarity and intentional decision-making.

interventions.title: Values Versus Social Expectations
interventions.description: Assisted client in distinguishing personally meaningful priorities from perceived external expectations to promote autonomous and values-consistent choices.
interventions.fullText: Values Versus Social Expectations: Assisted client in distinguishing personally meaningful priorities from perceived external expectations to promote autonomous and values-consistent choices.

interventions.title: Values in Relationships
interventions.description: Explored the qualities client wishes to embody in relationships and identified opportunities to express those values through communication and behavior.
interventions.fullText: Values in Relationships: Explored the qualities client wishes to embody in relationships and identified opportunities to express those values through communication and behavior.

interventions.title: Values-Based Boundary Exploration
interventions.description: Helped client identify boundaries that support personally meaningful values and explored how to communicate or maintain them while tolerating associated discomfort.
interventions.fullText: Values-Based Boundary Exploration: Helped client identify boundaries that support personally meaningful values and explored how to communicate or maintain them while tolerating associated discomfort.

interventions.title: Committed Action Planning
interventions.description: Collaboratively developed specific, values-consistent behavioral steps to support meaningful progress despite the presence of difficult thoughts or emotions.
interventions.fullText: Committed Action Planning: Collaboratively developed specific, values-consistent behavioral steps to support meaningful progress despite the presence of difficult thoughts or emotions.

interventions.title: Small-Step Action Planning
interventions.description: Helped client break values-consistent goals into manageable behavioral steps to reduce avoidance and facilitate implementation.
interventions.fullText: Small-Step Action Planning: Helped client break values-consistent goals into manageable behavioral steps to reduce avoidance and facilitate implementation.

interventions.title: Willingness-Based Behavioral Engagement
interventions.description: Encouraged client to engage in meaningful activities while allowing uncomfortable thoughts and emotions to be present rather than waiting for distress to resolve.
interventions.fullText: Willingness-Based Behavioral Engagement: Encouraged client to engage in meaningful activities while allowing uncomfortable thoughts and emotions to be present rather than waiting for distress to resolve.

interventions.title: Obstacles to Committed Action
interventions.description: Assisted client in identifying internal and external barriers to values-consistent behavior and developing flexible strategies for responding to those barriers.
interventions.fullText: Obstacles to Committed Action: Assisted client in identifying internal and external barriers to values-consistent behavior and developing flexible strategies for responding to those barriers.

interventions.title: Behavioral Follow-Through Review
interventions.description: Reviewed client’s efforts to implement previously identified values-based actions and explored barriers and opportunities for renewed commitment.
interventions.fullText: Behavioral Follow-Through Review: Reviewed client’s efforts to implement previously identified values-based actions and explored barriers and opportunities for renewed commitment.

interventions.title: Committed Action Despite Uncertainty
interventions.description: Supported client in identifying actionable steps toward meaningful goals without requiring complete certainty or reassurance before proceeding.
interventions.fullText: Committed Action Despite Uncertainty: Supported client in identifying actionable steps toward meaningful goals without requiring complete certainty or reassurance before proceeding.

interventions.title: Choice Point Exploration
interventions.description: Utilized the ACT choice point framework to help client identify behaviors that move them toward or away from personally meaningful values when difficult internal experiences arise.
interventions.fullText: Choice Point Exploration: Utilized the ACT choice point framework to help client identify behaviors that move them toward or away from personally meaningful values when difficult internal experiences arise.

interventions.title: Functional Analysis of Avoidance
interventions.description: Explored the short-term consequences and longer-term costs of avoidance behaviors to increase insight into how these patterns may restrict functioning.
interventions.fullText: Functional Analysis of Avoidance: Explored the short-term consequences and longer-term costs of avoidance behaviors to increase insight into how these patterns may restrict functioning.

interventions.title: Short-Term Relief Versus Long-Term Values Exploration
interventions.description: Supported client in examining the difference between behaviors that provide immediate relief and those that contribute to longer-term valued outcomes.
interventions.fullText: Short-Term Relief Versus Long-Term Values Exploration: Supported client in examining the difference between behaviors that provide immediate relief and those that contribute to longer-term valued outcomes.

interventions.title: Flexible Response Development
interventions.description: Helped client identify alternative responses to triggering situations that allow for difficult emotions while supporting meaningful engagement.
interventions.fullText: Flexible Response Development: Helped client identify alternative responses to triggering situations that allow for difficult emotions while supporting meaningful engagement.

interventions.title: Acceptance-Based Anxiety Management
interventions.description: Supported client in practicing willingness to experience anxiety while continuing to engage in personally meaningful activities rather than relying exclusively on avoidance or symptom control.
interventions.fullText: Acceptance-Based Anxiety Management: Supported client in practicing willingness to experience anxiety while continuing to engage in personally meaningful activities rather than relying exclusively on avoidance or symptom control.

interventions.title: Defusion From Feared Predictions
interventions.description: Assisted client in observing feared predictions as mental events and identifying actions that remain available regardless of uncertainty about future outcomes.
interventions.fullText: Defusion From Feared Predictions: Assisted client in observing feared predictions as mental events and identifying actions that remain available regardless of uncertainty about future outcomes.

interventions.title: Values-Based Behavioral Engagement
interventions.description: Collaboratively identified small, meaningful activities that reflect client values and supported engagement despite low mood or reduced motivation.
interventions.fullText: Values-Based Behavioral Engagement: Collaboratively identified small, meaningful activities that reflect client values and supported engagement despite low mood or reduced motivation.

interventions.title: Acceptance of Interpersonal Discomfort
interventions.description: Supported client in developing willingness to experience difficult emotions during interpersonal interactions while responding in accordance with personal values.
interventions.fullText: Acceptance of Interpersonal Discomfort: Supported client in developing willingness to experience difficult emotions during interpersonal interactions while responding in accordance with personal values.

interventions.title: Values-Consistent Communication Planning
interventions.description: Collaboratively identified communication strategies that reflect client values while acknowledging discomfort, uncertainty, or the possibility of disagreement.
interventions.fullText: Values-Consistent Communication Planning: Collaboratively identified communication strategies that reflect client values while acknowledging discomfort, uncertainty, or the possibility of disagreement.

interventions.title: Acceptance of Limited Control Over Others
interventions.description: Explored the distinction between behaviors within client’s control and the thoughts, feelings, or choices of other people to support adaptive interpersonal responding.
interventions.fullText: Acceptance of Limited Control Over Others: Explored the distinction between behaviors within client’s control and the thoughts, feelings, or choices of other people to support adaptive interpersonal responding.

interventions.title: Cognitive Defusion Through Metaphor
interventions.description: Utilized ACT-based metaphors to help client observe thoughts without becoming entangled in their content and increase flexibility in responding to internal experiences.
interventions.fullText: Cognitive Defusion Through Metaphor: Utilized ACT-based metaphors to help client observe thoughts without becoming entangled in their content and increase flexibility in responding to internal experiences.

interventions.title: Leaves on a Stream Exercise
interventions.description: Guided client through a mindfulness and defusion exercise involving visualization of thoughts passing by to practice observing cognitive experiences without engaging with them.
interventions.fullText: Leaves on a Stream Exercise: Guided client through a mindfulness and defusion exercise involving visualization of thoughts passing by to practice observing cognitive experiences without engaging with them.

interventions.title: Values-Based Action Assignment
interventions.description: Collaboratively established a specific between-session action aligned with identified values to support behavioral commitment and meaningful engagement.
interventions.fullText: Values-Based Action Assignment: Collaboratively established a specific between-session action aligned with identified values to support behavioral commitment and meaningful engagement.

interventions.title: ACT Skill Generalization

riskFactors.title: No Acute Risk Factors Identified
riskFactors.description: Client denied suicidal or homicidal ideation, intent, or plan. Denied NSSI, psychotic symptoms, or immediate safety vulnerabilities.

riskFactors.title: Non-Suicidal Self-Injury (NSSI) - Historical / Non-Acute
riskFactors.description: Client reports past history of NSSI; no urges or behaviors present within the past 30 days. Coping alternatives affirmed.

riskFactors.title: Passive Suicidal Ideation - No Intent or Plan
riskFactors.description: Client endorsed intermittent passive thoughts of wanting relief; denies intent, plan, or access to lethal means. Safety plan reviewed.

riskFactors.title: Active Suicidal Ideation - Safety Protocol Executed
riskFactors.description: Client expressed active thoughts with ambivalence. Comprehensive safety planning completed; emergency contacts and 988 crisis line reinforced.

riskFactors.title: Substance Misuse / High-Risk Coping
riskFactors.description: Client noted increased alcohol or sedative use in response to emotional distress. Relapse prevention strategies and harm reduction reviewed.

riskFactors.title: Intimate Partner Violence (IPV) - Screened & Monitored
riskFactors.description: Screened for emotional, physical, and psychological safety within relationship. Confidential safety resources provided.

riskFactors.title: Severe Panic & Dissociative Episodes
riskFactors.description: Episodes of derealization and hyperventilation experienced under stress. Grounding and 5-4-3-2-1 somatic strategies reinforced.

riskFactors.title: Acute Sleep Deprivation & Circadian Disruption
riskFactors.description: Client reported significant insomnia and fragmented sleep impacting daytime emotional regulation. Sleep hygiene and medical follow-up discussed.

riskFactors.title: Disordered Eating / Restrictive or Binge Urges
riskFactors.description: Monitored nutritional restriction and compensatory urges triggered by body-image distress. Multidisciplinary medical oversight affirmed.

riskFactors.title: Caregiver Burnout & Acute Environmental Exhaustion
riskFactors.description: Client experiencing chronic role overload and secondary stress without adequate respite support. Protective boundaries and crisis supports reviewed.

riskFactors.title: Financial / Housing Instability Stressors
riskFactors.description: Assessed acute socioeconomic stressors affecting baseline safety and treatment adherence; community resource navigation provided.

riskFactors.title: Medication Non-Adherence / Side-Effect Distress
riskFactors.description: Client reported skipped doses of prescribed psychotropic medication; encouraged prompt communication with prescribing clinician.
